description: Update address metadata (not entries). Name cannot be changed. Updates memory ingestion if description changes.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Updated address result with keys: address (the updated address record), message (confirmation)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Updates address metadata (type, description, tags) but not entries. Name is immutable. Description changes trigger memory re-ingestion.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: no address exists with the given name. ValidationError: invalid metadata values. NoChangesError: no fields were provided to update.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found: use 'search' to find addresses or 'register' to create. For validation errors: check that provided values are valid. For no changes: provide at least one of address_type, description, or tags.
